title: Daily Market Digest - October 25, 2026
subtitle: Markets Closed Today - Recap of Friday, October 23, 2026 Session

items.headline: U.S. Equities Closed Lower Friday Amid Inflation Fears and AI Sector Jitters
items.summary: U.S. stock markets finished lower on Friday, October 23, 2026, as renewed inflation concerns driven by rising oil prices and mounting skepticism around the sustainability of AI-related investments weighed heavily on investor sentiment. Major indices saw declines, with tech and communication services sectors particularly impacted. Markets are closed today, Sunday, October 25, 2026. This is not financial advice.

items.headline: Crown Castle rallies on strong performance
items.summary: Crown Castle International led S&P 500 gainers with a 9.1% increase on Friday.

items.headline: Robert Half surges on Q3 beat and raised outlook
items.summary: Shares of Robert Half advanced 15% after the staffing firm reported better-than-expected Q3 adjusted EPS and revenue, alongside a raised Q4 outlook.

items.headline: Nautilus Biotechnology leads broader market gainers
items.summary: Nautilus Biotechnology experienced a significant surge, gaining 24.6% to lead gainers within Trefis' coverage universe.

items.headline: Bloom Energy drops significantly
items.summary: Bloom Energy was among the weakest performers in the S&P 500, declining 11.2% on Friday.

items.headline: LKQ Corp falls sharply
items.summary: LKQ Corp posted a substantial decline of 22.5%, marking it as the weakest showing within the broader market's coverage universe.

items.headline: Meta Platforms pressured by Q3 legal settlement
items.summary: Meta Platforms saw its stock close lower at $642.62, down 0.96% on Friday, following a significant $9.89 billion charge tied to a legal settlement that impacted its Q3 EPS.

items.headline: U.S. Business Activity Expands, but Selling Prices Rise at Fastest Pace Since August 2022
items.summary: S&P Global's flash survey for October indicated continued expansion in U.S. business activity, but also noted that selling prices are increasing at their quickest rate since August 2022, signaling renewed inflation concerns.

items.headline: Sharp Market Rotation Away from AI Stocks Continues
items.summary: Last week saw a distinct shift in equity markets, with investors pulling back from AI-related stocks, leading to notable declines in semiconductor and tech-heavy indexes. Conversely, more defensive sectors such as utilities, consumer staples, and healthcare outperformed.

items.headline: Rising Oil Prices Fuel Inflation Fears, Complicating Fed's Path
items.summary: Surging oil prices contributed to a lower close on Wall Street Friday, intensifying inflation concerns and potentially complicating the Federal Reserve's efforts to manage price pressures, especially with the 10-year Treasury yield near 5%.

items.headline: Hasbro Stock Jumps on Strong Q3 Earnings Driven by Magic: The Gathering
items.summary: Hasbro shares surged this week after the company reported robust third-quarter earnings and revenue that surpassed Wall Street expectations, largely attributed to surging demand for its Magic: The Gathering franchise. Management also raised its full-year profit outlook.
